$schema_note: AI / agent observability meters. Every value copied from the vendor's own page on checked date. Guarded by build.mjs (RT-20261031-119): printed rates on guides/ai-agent-observability-pricing-2026 must equal these values.

meters.unit: generation (one AI model call your app makes)
meters.free: 30k generations/mo (Free and Pro); 25M system-initiated tokens/mo for Evals & Guards
meters.extra: Evals & Guards tokens $2 per 1M beyond the pool; telemetry billed separately; Pro platform fee $19/mo
meters.effective_note: Billing starts October 1, 2026; not billed retroactively

meters.free: List footnote: "40k LLM spans are free"
meters.price_display: $160/mo for the first 100k LLM spans, then $3.50 per 10K (15-day retention, billed annually)
meters.extra: 30/60/90-day retention $5/$6.50/$7.50 per 10K LLM spans (annual); on-demand $240 first 100k, $5 per 10K (15-day)
meters.effective_note: On the list page 2026-10-31; Datadog does not publish an effective date

meters.extra: $1 month-to-month, $1.20 on-demand; failed evaluations not billed
meters.effective_note: On the list page 2026-10-31; Datadog does not publish an effective date

meters.free: None stated; each package includes 500M Luna tokens and 5 Luna fine-tuning runs per year
meters.extra: Additional Luna tokens and extended retention available (price not listed)
meters.effective_note: On splunk.com/pricing 2026-10-31; Splunk does not publish an effective date

meters.unit: AI unit (LLM work Dynatrace runs for you)
meters.free: AI Exploration included; Agentic Operations tasks in Dynatrace Assist not billed for a limited time
meters.extra: Dynatrace's average per call: 2 units (DQL to natural language), 3 (chat via your app), 8 (natural language to DQL), 30 (autonomous multi-step investigation)
meters.effective_note: On the pricing page and rate card 2026-10-31; Dynatrace does not publish an effective date

meters.free: 3 active AI users (40M tokens each) + 25M tokens/mo for service-account (system-initiated) usage
meters.price_display: $20 per active AI user (40M tokens included), then $2 per 1M tokens
meters.extra: From 2026-12-01 Watcher runs and calibration are billed as Assistant tokens from the shared system-initiated pool (free until then); no per-watcher or per-run fee

meters.free: Paid: 50 GB ingest + 10 GB-month storage per billing cycle; Free: 0.5 GB/day, 7-day retention
meters.price_display: $0.25 per GB ingested + $0.10 per GB-month stored
meters.extra: Covers Workers Logs/Traces, Cloudflare Traces, Containers logs, R2 data access logs, AI Gateway logs; Enterprise moves at contract renewal; Log Explorer stays $1/GB
meters.effective_note: Existing Workers Observability customers move on December 1, 2026; no retroactive charges
